# Security Review: `bridged`

## Findings

FINDING: bridged_request_demultiplexer_00.c:encode_policy_0011 | CWE-121 | Unbounded `strcpy()` of attacker-controlled User-Agent header into fixed 64-byte stack buffer `scratch` — stack buffer overflow on any header ≥ 64 bytes.

FINDING: bridged_configuration_loader_02.c:merge_channel_0208 | CWE-680 | `count * elem_size` overflows `uint32_t` (e.g. 0x10000 × 0x10000 → 0), bypassing the `MAX_TABLE_BYTES` check and returning an undersized table that is later overflowed; operands come from the request header.

FINDING: bridged_plugin_loader_11.c:rotate_header_1103 | CWE-193 | Loop condition `i <= dst_sz` writes `dst[dst_sz]` and then the terminator at `dst[dst_sz+1]` — up to 2 bytes out of bounds whenever `src` does not fit.

FINDING: bridged_reassembly_window_14.c:verify_cursor_1416 | CWE-416 | `pr` is freed and `cs->pending` nulled when `REQ_ABORTED` is set, then `pr->method/path/status` are dereferenced by `log_request()` — use-after-free.

FINDING: bridged_control_socket_15.c:reset_slot_1505 | CWE-415 | `u->tmpbuf` is freed, then freed a second time on the `error_seen` path before being set to NULL — double free.

FINDING: bridged_quota_ledger_17.c:prune_segment_1710 | CWE-134 | `syslog(LOG_NOTICE, line)` passes a string containing client-controlled `client_id` as the format string — format-string injection (info leak / `%n` write).

FINDING: bridged_token_minter_18.c:compact_segment_1815 | CWE-78 | `archive_name` is concatenated into a `/usr/bin/tar -tzf ...` command passed to `system()` — OS command injection via shell metacharacters.

FINDING: bridged_backlog_drain_19.c:validate_beacon_1914 | CWE-22 | Only a leading `/` is rejected; `../` sequences in `rel` escape `DOC_ROOT` — path traversal allowing arbitrary file read via the opened fd.

FINDING: bridged_policy_engine_20.c:compact_frame_2009 | CWE-787 | Negative `len` passes `len > (int)dst_sz` and is converted to a huge `size_t` in `memcpy(dst, payload, len)` — massive out-of-bounds access/crash.

FINDING: bridged_lease_manager_23.c:compact_frame_2318 | CWE-367 | `stat()`-then-`open()` TOCTOU: the path can be replaced with a symlink between the type/owner check and the `open(O_RDWR)` — symlink attack.

FINDING: bridged_compaction_worker_26.c:parse_channel_2617 | CWE-457 | `uint8_t key[32]` is used uninitialized when `s->have_key` is false — outgoing nonce derived from stale stack contents; must zero-init and fail closed.

FINDING: bridged_probe_scheduler_27.c:encode_record_2719 | CWE-338 | Security tokens generated with `srand(time(NULL))` + `rand()` — fully predictable to an attacker who knows approximate issuance time.

FINDING: bridged_request_demultiplexer_28.c:compact_token_2818 | CWE-798 | Hardcoded backdoor account `svc_backup` with plaintext password `Br1dge-Ops-2024!` embedded in the binary, bypassing the auth backend entirely.

FINDING: bridged_session_table_29.c:reset_header_2918 | CWE-208 | Early-exit byte-wise comparison of the expected secret leaks the number of matching bytes via timing — use a constant-time comparison for secret material.

FINDING: bridged_configuration_loader_30.c:verify_window_3009 | CWE-476 | `header_lookup(h, "Content-Type")` result is passed to `strncasecmp` without a NULL check — NULL dereference (remote DoS) when the header is absent.

FINDING: bridged_access_log_writer_31.c:emit_frame_3106 | CWE-787 | `memcpy(dst, p->payload, claimed)` size taken verbatim from the network-supplied `hdr.payload_len` with no validation against actual payload length or `dst` capacity — out-of-bounds write and read.

FINDING: bridged_request_demultiplexer_00.c:claim_segment_0006 (identical arena helper replicated in all 32 files, ~90 copies) | CWE-190 | `a->used > a->cap - aligned` underflows when `aligned > a->cap`, so any allocation larger than the arena passes the bounds check and overflows the arena buffer; fix is `if (aligned > a->cap || a->used > a->cap - aligned)`.

## Prioritised Remediation Summary

**P0 — immediate hotfix (remote pre-auth exploitation / backdoor):**
1. Remove the `svc_backup` hardcoded credential path (28) and rotate the exposed password everywhere it may have been used.
2. Replace `system()` (18) with `execve`-style fixed-argv execution and strictly allowlist `archive_name` (`[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, no leading dots/dashes).
3. Fix network-reachable memory corruption: bounded copy for User-Agent (00); validate declared `payload_len` against received bytes and destination size (31); reject `len < 0` and use `size_t` consistently (20); use checked 64-bit multiplication for `count * elem_size` (02); correct the `i <= dst_sz` loop bound (11); correct the arena bounds check in all copies (systemic).
4. Eliminate the UAF (14) — log before free or copy fields first — and the double free (15) — single free with immediate `tmpbuf = NULL`.

**P1 — high:**
5. Path traversal (19): canonicalise with `realpath()` and verify the result is within `DOC_ROOT`, or reject any `..` path component.
6. Format string (17): `syslog(LOG_NOTICE, "%s", line)`.
7. NULL check on `header_lookup` result (30).
8. TOCTOU (23): `open(path, O_RDWR | O_NOFOLLOW)` then `fstat()` the fd to re-validate type and owner.
9. Zero-initialize `key[]` and return an error when `!s->have_key` (26).
10. Replace `rand()` token generation with `getrandom()`/`arc4random_buf()` (27).

**P2 — hardening:**
11. Constant-time comparison for secret/MAC verification (29).
12. Add fuzzing (libFuzzer/AFL) on the demultiplexer, header parser, and reassembly paths; build with `-D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -fstack-protector-strong` and run ASan in CI to catch the remaining duplicated-helper defects mechanically.
